incidents.name: RoyalRoyalties
incidents.notes: Royal1155LDA incremented per-tier balance bookkeeping even for zero-amount batch items, inflating tierBalanceOf to 100 vs supply 1 so Royalties paid a 100x claim.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0xd5b297c08d890376b6cbdba6023a39ffbdf65c78 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x7c885c4bfd179fb59f1056fbea319d579a278075, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (101436850s -> 101430522s)
